claim: For each component i of a finite family a : Fin m → GibbsOperator n, under the existing self-adjoint Gibbs Hamiltonian, positive partition, continuous derivations D and E, and self-adjointness of the first component readout, the real mixed Gibbs log-partition Hessian on that component equals the dissipative bilinear form of finiteGibbsCEOnsagerSystem specialized to a i.

carrier.type: Fin m family of GibbsOperator n values, encoded through the existing CE one-cochain family into NOperatorForm m, with each selected component extracted as Op1Form ℝ (realDerivationsLane (GibbsOperator n)).L (GibbsOperator n)
operations: component evaluation of the existing NOperatorForm embedding
real derivation direction induced by a continuous complex Fréchet derivation
finite Gibbs CE Onsager dissipative bilinear form
conventions: the system is specialized separately to the observable a i at the same family index in both dissipative slots
the two derivation directions D and E are independent
self-adjointness is required only for the first CE readout, as in the Gibbs Hessian owner
this is a diagonal family-index result and does not identify cross-index response with a single-observable Onsager system
